# Svelte

Use this skill for Svelte and SvelteKit code changes in this repository.

## Reference

- https://svelte.dev/docs/svelte/best-practices/llms.txt

## Guidance

1. Fetch and follow the official best-practices llms.txt guidance when making Svelte changes.
2. Prefer idiomatic Svelte patterns and avoid anti-patterns covered in the reference.
3. Keep changes minimal and aligned with existing project conventions.
